<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity Value'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY imgdata SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising processor comment handlers -->
  <?sub:pi processing-instruction-data="true"?>
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <child>&ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.w3.org/default" xmlns:m="http://www.w3.org/metadata" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment with special characters: <xml> & "quotes" -->
  <m:metadata>
    <?m:info status="active"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw text inside metadata CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <item>&ent2; <sub xmlns="http://www.w3.org/default">Sub-element text</sub></item>
</catalog>

]>

    <?ext:action run="true"?>
    <![CDATA[

    ]]>
  </ext:section>
  <section>&global-ent; &local-pe;</section>
</document>

<project xmlns="http://xml.project.org/core" xmlns:ns="http://xml.project.org/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Project description comment containing entity references like &nestedEnt; -->
  <ns:task xlink:type="simple">
    <?ns:directive execute="now"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <![CDATA[ Nested-looking CDATA construct simulation ]]>
    ]]>
  </ns:task>
  <task>&nestedEnt; <subtask>Subtask Content</subtask></task>
</project>
